perspective:
From Arthur Chung’s available perspective:

- He knows he is Arthur Chung, a plumber with a doctorate. He knows Teresa Ortega as a medical assistant and colleague in community service projects; he respects her and is committed to helping others.
- **Scenario 1:** He notices Teresa working hard and appearing overwhelmed. He feels concerned, believes she needs help, and offers assistance. Teresa says she can manage but has a lot to do. He urges self-care and working faster together. Teresa accepts and asks for help organizing medical supplies. He begins helping.
- **Scenario 2:** He believes Teresa hesitated because she wants to prove her capability. He feels empathy and wants to reassure her. He tells her he admires her self-reliance, but accepting help does not mean she is incapable. Teresa says she wants to show she can do it herself. He says teamwork is more effective and not about proving anything. Teresa says he is right and she sometimes needs reminding. He says they are in this together and he supports her.
- **Scenario 3:** He believes Teresa is still struggling. He feels frustrated that his help is not yielding results and wants another way to support her without making her feel inadequate. He tells her things still seem tough and she is doing a great job. Teresa says it has been busy and she feels behind. He proposes working together instead of just him helping. Teresa agrees. He says they will tackle it as a team.
- **Scenario 4:** He feels hopeful that collaboration will ease her burden and improve efficiency, and intends to commit to it. He tells Teresa he is hopeful. Teresa says it already feels less overwhelming. He suggests he handle inventory while she manages patient records, checking in regularly. Teresa agrees. He says they should make it a productive day.
- **Scenario 5:** He believes their teamwork strengthened their professional relationship and feels satisfied. He tells Teresa their teamwork paid off. Teresa agrees it was a great experience. He suggests continuing collaboration in future projects. Teresa says that is a fantastic idea and that they have proven efficiency and effectiveness as a team. He says they should keep it up and looks forward to their next project. Teresa says she does too and thanks him for being a supportive colleague.
